item.description:
Onigiri 3.0.1

Onigiri now has one home. Downloads, updates and the Homebrew install all live in one place: github.com/joan-chiangwq/onigiri

  • Installed with Homebrew? Paste this into Terminal once. It reinstalls Onigiri from the new home. Your settings are kept. 
    brew update && brew untap --force joan-chiangwq/onigiri && brew tap joan-chiangwq/onigiri https://github.com/joan-chiangwq/onigiri && brew trust joan-chiangwq/onigiri && brew install --cask onigiri
    After that, brew upgrade --cask onigiri works as usual.
  • Downloaded Onigiri directly? You're all set. This update moves you over automatically.
